title: Birdsong（机经听写）
titleCn: 鸟鸣声对工作效率与情绪的影响

paragraphs.text: Previous studies on sound failed to identify differences in natural sounds.
More recent research has shown that birdsong helped concentration most when it had no repetition.
Researchers are investigating if workers' creatively is increased when listening to birdsong.
Studies aim to see if birdsong helps workers when they are feeling tired potentially boosting their productivity and well-being.
A survey was done to investigate people's reactions to various sounds such as birdsong and the sound of water.
Participants will be shown a frightening movie during which their verbal responses and physical reactions will be measured.
These measures will help to determine participants' verbal responses and physical reactions.
It has already been trialled in one airport waiting area to create a more calming environment for travelers.
In the future, similar techniques could be used to help children in the hospital providing them with a soothing auditory environment to alleviate stress and anxiety.

transcriptHtml:
Previous studies on sound failed to identify differences in natural sounds.

More recent research has shown that birdsong helped concentration most when it had no repetition.

Researchers are investigating if workers' creatively is increased when listening to birdsong.

Studies aim to see if birdsong helps workers when they are feeling tired potentially boosting their productivity and well-being.

A survey was done to investigate people's reactions to various sounds such as birdsong and the sound of water.

Participants will be shown a frightening movie during which their verbal responses and physical reactions will be measured.

These measures will help to determine participants' verbal responses and physical reactions.

It has already been trialled in one airport waiting area to create a more calming environment for travelers.

In the future, similar techniques could be used to help children in the hospital providing them with a soothing auditory environment to alleviate stress and anxiety.
